description: Researchers at the American University of Sharjah and University of Sharjah publish cyclic tests and finite-element results for six buckling-restrained brace specimens. The 2022 Zenodo release compares fully threaded, threaded-notched and smooth-shaved core bars with replaceable cores and innovative end units. Excel workbooks document component dimensions, material strength, load–displacement hysteresis, secant stiffness and cumulative energy dissipation. CC BY 4.0 permits free access and reuse. These laboratory measurements can calibrate nonlinear structural simulations for seismic retrofitting. The small specimen set limits generalisation across brace geometries, and published analytical results do not establish that an executable ABAQUS model is included. No directly related catalogue benchmark was identified.
